designs.title: D · 체결 펄스
designs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: one premium Linux desktop app icon for Hoga Ops, a professional Korean stock orderbook and chart terminal. Square composition. Deep graphite (#121216) rounded-square tile occupying 90% of canvas with genuinely transparent outside corners. One solid warm amber (#F0B429) emblem centered on the tile. Quiet industrial financial terminal identity. Flat vector-like precision, bold strokes, balanced negative space, recognizable at 32 pixels. No text or letters, no numbers, no candles, no upward chart line, no gradients, textures, shadows, glow, bevels, 3D, mockup, watermark, tiny details or decorative border. Subject: a distinctive TRADE PULSE emblem. Two bold horizontal pill-shaped bars approach a single central solid diamond, one from the left at upper-middle height and one from the right at lower-middle height. The diamond is the executed trade and the offset bars suggest two incoming orders meeting. There are exactly three disconnected amber shapes, composed compactly as one memorable mark with generous gaps. Convey speed, precision and matching without arrows, electrical bolts, graph axes or a literal heartbeat. Optically balance the asymmetric mark.
